name: Tapey
subtitle: Washi-tape photo wallpapers
summary: Pick your photos and they settle onto the wall like prints. Add washi tape and frames, then save the wallpaper exactly as you see it.

sections.title: Photos find their place
body: Pick your photos and Tapey lays them out like prints on a wall. Drag a photo to move it, or use two fingers to resize and turn it. Any photo you move by hand stays pinned where you put it.
bullets: Up to 12 photos, or 30 with Tapey Pro
Auto, Grid, Stairs, Heart, and Circle layouts
Undo and redo

sections.title: Tape and frames
body: Pick a tape color and the tape goes on. Change where it sits and its pattern, or give it torn ends. In a Polaroid frame, every photo can carry its own handwritten note.
bullets: 8 tape colors, 4 patterns, and 8 Pro patterns
White borders and Polaroid frames
B&W for the whole wall or a single photo

sections.title: Fitted to the lock screen
body: The current time sits on the canvas just like your lock screen clock. Drag the handle to set the clock space, and the photos move down below it. You can keep room for widgets as well, and the resolution is matched to your device from the start.
bullets: Adjustable clock space
Reserved widget space
iPhone and iPad resolutions

sections.title: Start with your photos
body: No account and nothing to sign in to. Go through Photos, Clock, Layout, Background, Tape, and Frame with Next, and the last step saves. Your wall is still there when you come back, and Make a new one after saving moves it to Recent.

a: On the start screen, tap Add photos, then choose your photos. You can also drag photos in from another app. While editing, tap Add in the Photos step.
Each wallpaper holds up to 12 photos, or 30 with Tapey Pro. The Heart layout appears once you have 6 or more. Circle needs 8 or more, and Star, a Tapey Pro layout, needs 10 or more.

Tap the save button at the top right of the editor, or Save on the last step. The wallpaper goes to the Photos app as a PNG at the resolution chosen in Settings. The first time, iOS asks whether Tapey may add photos.
If saving fails, allow photo access in Settings > Tapey.
Tapey shows one full-screen ad when you save a wallpaper. Google AdMob picks and serves that ad.
If the ad can't load, or your last save failed, Tapey saves right away without an ad.

faq.q: Tapey Pro and restoring the purchase
a: Buy Tapey Pro from the menu or the start screen. You pay once, and it is not a subscription. After that, no ad appears when you save, and you can use up to 30 photos, the premium tapes, and the new frames and layouts. Before buying, you can still pick Pro items to preview them. If you save with them in place, you choose between Buy Tapey Pro, Save with basic items, and Keep editing.

On a new device or after reinstalling, open Settings from the menu and tap Restore purchase. With the same Apple Account, you won't be charged again. If you bought Remove ads earlier, you already have Tapey Pro.

The first time you open the app, as it gets ads ready, iOS asks whether Tapey may track you. If you have Tapey Pro, it doesn't ask. The app works the same either way, and you can change your answer in Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.

Where ad consent is required, such as the European Economic Area, change your choices under Ad preferences at the bottom of the start screen. There, the consent form appears before the tracking prompt.

Copies of the photos and background photos you pick, along with the layout and notes, are kept in the app's storage so you can pick up where you left off. Start over in the menu clears the current work, and deleting the app removes everything.
Tapping Make a new one after saving moves the current work to Recent. Recent keeps 3 projects and drops the oldest when a new one comes in.
Open the image you just saved in the Photos app, tap Share, then choose Use as Wallpaper. Pick Lock Screen and tap Set.
The same steps are under How to set it as wallpaper on the screen that appears after saving.
Tapey runs on iPad too. There it makes a square wallpaper that works in both portrait and landscape, and the editor lets you switch between the two views.
To make an iPhone wallpaper on your iPad, pick an iPhone size under Resolution in Settings.
Arranging, decorating, and saving work offline. Ads, buying Tapey Pro, and restoring the purchase need a connection.

The handwriting fonts for notes are installed with the app. One is used when the app language is Korean, another for all other languages. Characters those fonts don't include appear in the system font.
Close the app completely, open it again, and check that you have the latest version from the App Store. If the problem continues, email us with the screen you were on and what you were doing.

privacy.title: Tapey Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: The developer does not collect personal information. The ad shown when you save comes from Google AdMob, which processes device information such as the advertising identifier. Apple handles payment for Tapey Pro.
intro: kvndh ("the developer") handles the personal information of people who use the Tapey app ("the app") under Korea's Personal Information Protection Act, as set out below.

sections.title: Purpose of processing
paragraphs: The app has no sign-up or login, and the developer does not collect personal information from users.
When you save a wallpaper, the app shows one full-screen ad. Google's ad service AdMob selects and displays that ad, and uses device information to show ads and measure how they perform.

sections.title: Information processed
paragraphs: The developer collects no personal information. The data the app uses is listed below. All of it is kept in the app's storage on your device. If you update from a version earlier than 2.0.0, the app reads the work and settings that the earlier version stored on the device once, the first time it opens, and moves them to the new storage location. The earlier data is left in place. The developer does not receive any of this data.
Information that AdMob may collect when showing ads is listed in section 9.
bullets: Copies of the photos and background photos you pick: used to reopen your work
Layout and decoration settings, photo notes: used to reopen your work
Up to 3 recent projects with preview images: used for Recent on the start screen

Language choice, Tapey Pro purchase status, save count and whether the rating request was shown, whether the first-run guides were shown, view mode choice, screen layout settings carried over from an earlier version: used to run the app and to time the rating request

sections.title: Processing and retention period
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information. Data in the app's storage is deleted when you delete the app. The preview file made for sharing when you save is kept in a temporary folder and removed the next time the app opens. Wallpapers saved to the Photos app are deleted in the Photos app.
Information collected by AdMob is kept according to Google's Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy).

sections.title: Disclosure to third parties
paragraphs: The developer does not provide users' personal information to third parties. When an ad is shown, however, the Google Mobile Ads SDK built into the app sends the information in section 9 directly to Google, as follows.
bullets: Recipient: Google LLC (United States), AdMob
Purpose: showing ads and measuring ad performance
Information: the device information and ad interaction records listed in section 9
When and how: sent over the internet when an ad is loaded and shown
Retention: as set out in Google's Privacy Policy

sections.title: Outsourcing of processing
paragraphs: The developer does not outsource the processing of personal information. Apple processes payment for Tapey Pro through the App Store, and payment information is governed by Apple's privacy policy. The developer does not receive your payment method or Apple Account details.

sections.title: Destruction of information
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information, so there is nothing to destroy. Start over in the menu clears your current work, and deleting the app removes all of its data.

sections.title: Rights of users and legal guardians, and how to exercise them
paragraphs: Because the developer holds no personal information, there is nothing to access, correct, or delete. If you have questions, email us at the address below.

You can ask Google to give you access to, or delete, information collected by AdMob (policies.google.com/privacy). To refuse use of the advertising identifier, follow section 9. Payment information is held by Apple and is covered by Apple's privacy policy (apple.com/legal/privacy).

sections.title: Security measures
paragraphs: Only the photos you choose in the iOS photo picker or drag into the app are passed to the app. The app does not ask for camera access or for permission to read your photo library. When saving a finished wallpaper, the app uses only the permission to add photos.

sections.title: Automatic collection and how to refuse it
paragraphs: The app does not use cookies or analytics tools. It includes the Google Mobile Ads SDK (AdMob) for advertising, which may collect the information below when it loads and shows ads.

When you open the app and it gets ads ready, iOS shows the App Tracking Transparency (ATT) prompt if you haven't answered it yet. It is not shown when you save. If you don't allow tracking, AdMob does not receive the advertising identifier (IDFA), and ads still appear. You can change this in iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.

In regions where ad consent is required, such as the European Economic Area, Google's consent form appears first. If the result is that ads can't be requested, the tracking prompt is not shown either. There, you can change your choices under Ad preferences at the bottom of the start screen.

After you buy Tapey Pro (including an earlier Remove ads purchase), no ads appear, and from the next launch the app no longer starts AdMob, so neither the consent form nor the tracking prompt appears.
bullets: Device identifiers, and the advertising identifier (IDFA) if you allow tracking
Approximate location estimated from your IP address
Ad interaction records such as impressions and taps
App performance, crash, and diagnostic information

sections.title: Privacy officer
paragraphs: If you have questions about personal information, email us at the address below.

sections.title: Remedies for privacy concerns
paragraphs: If you need advice about a privacy concern or help settling a dispute, you can contact the Korean bodies listed below. If you live outside Korea, you can also contact the data protection authority in your country.
bullets: Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972 in Korea (www.kopico.go.kr)
Personal Information Infringement Report Center: 118 in Korea (privacy.kisa.or.kr)
Supreme Prosecutors' Office: 1301 in Korea (www.spo.go.kr)
National Police Agency: 182 in Korea (ecrm.police.go.kr)
European Union and EEA: the data protection authority of your country (edpb.europa.eu)
United Kingdom: Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk)
United States: Federal Trade Commission (reportfraud.ftc.gov)
Other countries: the data protection or consumer protection authority where you live
